versions.content: When development error detection is enabled for the Wdg module: The Wdg_SetMode function shall check that the (hardware specific) settings for the requested mode are within the allowed boundaries. If this is not the case, the Specification of Watchdog Driver AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 30 of 44 Document ID 39 : AUTOSAR_SWS_WatchdogDriver - AUTOSAR confidential - function shall not execute the mode switch but raise the development error WDG_E_PARAM_MODE and return with the value E_NOT_OK .
